text: Escape items and swing wings become useless once Jerin joins the party.

evidence.quote: Carry lots of sweet water, some escapes and swing wings(these two are useless after you get Jerin)

subject: Poison marsh
text: Many hidden items can be discovered by using the Float spell to explore poison marshes.

evidence.quote: Explore every single poison marsh of the game(with float spell), because there are lots of items hidden there.

subject: Tower of Light
text: A Might helmet is found at the top of the Tower of Light in the chest where the Light key normally appears.

evidence.quote:
Go 
to the tower of light and explore it to the top. In the chest where was 
supposed to be the Light key, there's a might helmet.
